summary: Paroxetine is an SSRI used for major depression and a broad range of anxiety disorders. It carries a boxed warning for increased suicidal thoughts/behavior in pediatric and young adult patients. It has notable anticholinergic effects, the highest discontinuation-syndrome risk among SSRIs, and is a potent CYP2D6 inhibitor.

dosage.d: Start 20 mg once daily; titrate by 10 mg/day at >=1 week intervals
Start 20 mg once daily; usual target 40 mg/day
Start 10 mg once daily; titrate to 40 mg/day

admin: Administer as a single daily dose in the morning
Taper gradually on discontinuation to avoid withdrawal symptoms
moa: Selectively inhibits neuronal reuptake of serotonin (5-HT), potentiating serotonergic neurotransmission in the CNS. Minimal effect on norepinephrine and dopamine reuptake.
preg: Avoid where possible, particularly in the first trimester. Paroxetine is associated with a less than 2-fold increase in cardiovascular malformations with first-trimester exposure. Late-pregnancy use may cause persistent pulmonary hypertension of the newborn (PPHN) and poor neonatal adaptation. US former category D.
lact: Excreted into breast milk in small amounts; generally considered compatible with breastfeeding. Monitor infant for irritability, poor feeding, and somnolence.
renal: Severe renal impairment (CrCl <30 mL/min): start 10 mg/day, maximum 40 mg/day. Plasma concentrations are increased.
hepatic: Severe hepatic impairment: start 10 mg/day, maximum 40 mg/day. Increased plasma concentrations.

major: Tamoxifen (paroxetine reduces active metabolite via CYP2D6 inhibition)
interactions.alcohol: Avoid - additive CNS effects though no pharmacokinetic interaction shown
interactions.diagnostics: May cause false-positive urine screening tests; can affect TCA assays

monitoring: Suicidality and mood changes (especially first weeks and dose changes)

pearls: Highest risk of discontinuation syndrome among SSRIs due to short half-life and no active metabolite

missed: Take the missed dose as soon as remembered the same day; if it is almost time for the next dose, skip it. Do not double the dose.
overdose: Symptoms include somnolence, nausea/vomiting, tachycardia, tremor, dizziness; serotonin syndrome and (rarely) seizures or QT changes. Management is supportive with airway protection, activated charcoal if early, ECG and cardiac monitoring; no specific antidote.
